title: payment-svc pointing to staging DB after deploy — DB_HOST misconfigured
description: Deploy a1b2c3d4 at 14:00Z set DB_HOST=db-staging.internal instead of db-prod.internal in production configmap. payment-svc lost all DB connectivity immediately. 100% error rate on POST /v1/payments since deploy. Rollback initiated at 14:05Z. Root cause: wrong value committed to k8s/production/payment-svc/configmap.yaml.

title: Add config validation to deployment pipeline — prevent wrong DB_HOST in production
description: Deploy pipeline has no guard against staging values leaking into production configs. Add pre-deploy linting step that asserts DB_HOST matches expected production hostname pattern. Also add integration test that verifies DB connectivity immediately after deploy before traffic is shifted.
